title: 空白正規化 / Whitespace normalization
prompt: Return a string with leading/trailing whitespace removed and every internal whitespace run replaced by one ASCII space. Treat Unicode whitespace as whitespace. Do not change non-whitespace characters.

title: 保留順序去重 / Stable deduplication
prompt: Given a list of integers, remove duplicates while preserving each value's first-appearance order. Return a new list and do not mutate the input.
attribution: Original project repair task inspired by research evaluation principles; not an official benchmark sample.

title: 重複計數 / Frequency table
prompt: Given a list of strings, return a dictionary mapping each exact string to its occurrence count. Case and empty strings are significant. Do not mutate input. Each input string is at most 100 characters.
attribution: Original project repair task inspired by research evaluation principles; not an official benchmark sample.

title: 分段與尾端資料 / Chunk sequence
prompt: Input has items (a list) and size (an integer). Return consecutive chunks of size elements, preserving a shorter final chunk. Empty items yields []. A nonpositive size raises ValueError. Do not mutate input.
baseline:
def solve(data):
    items = data["items"]
    size = data["size"]
    out = []
    for i in range(0, len(items) - size + 1, size):
        out.append(items[i:i+size])
    return out
attribution: Original project repair task inspired by research evaluation principles; not an official benchmark sample.

title: 重複值二分搜尋 / First-match binary search
prompt: Input has sorted nondecreasing integer items and integer target. Return the index of the first occurrence, or -1 when absent. Empty items is valid. Do not mutate input.

title: 重疊區間合併 / Merge intervals
prompt: Given integer [start,end] pairs in any order, return sorted merged intervals. Overlapping or touching endpoints merge. A reversed interval raises ValueError. Empty input returns []. Do not mutate input.
attribution: Original project repair task inspired by research evaluation principles; not an official benchmark sample.

title: 括號順序驗證 / Balanced brackets
prompt: Given a string, return whether (), [] and {} are properly nested and matched. Ignore other characters. Empty string is balanced.
baseline:
def solve(data):
    return data.count("(") == data.count(")") and data.count("[") == data.count("]") and data.count("{") == data.count("}")

title: 排序與偶數中位數 / Median
prompt: Return the median of a nonempty list of finite numbers. For even lengths average the two middle sorted values. Empty input raises ValueError. Do not mutate input.

title: 有號小數解析 / Signed decimal parser
prompt: Parse a decimal string after stripping outer whitespace. Allow an optional leading + or -, at most one decimal point, and at least one ASCII digit. Forms .5 and 3. are valid. Reject exponent notation, underscores, NaN, infinity, internal whitespace and other characters with ValueError. Return a finite number. Magnitude must not exceed 1000000; larger or nonfinite parsed values raise ValueError.
attribution: Original project repair task inspired by research evaluation principles; not an official benchmark sample.

title: 連續區段編碼 / Run-length encoding
prompt: Return a list of [character,count] pairs for consecutive identical Unicode code points. Separate nonadjacent runs of the same character. Empty string returns []. Input contains at most 200 code points.
attribution: Original project repair task inspired by research evaluation principles; not an official benchmark sample.

title: 累積餘額 / Prefix balances
prompt: Given integer balance changes, return the running total after each change starting from zero. Preserve order; empty input returns []. Do not mutate input. Inputs guarantee that every running total has magnitude at most 1000000.
reference:
def solve(data):
    balance = 0
    out = []
    for amount in data:
        balance += amount
        out.append(balance)
    return out
